dedupe_keys.name: tidal stream cable agreements england wales ni the crown estate

description: The Crown Estate publishes boundaries of export-cable agreements for tidal-stream developments in English, Welsh and Northern Irish waters. The description says boundaries reflect signed Agreements for Lease and Lease documents. These are agreement extents and do not prove that a cable has been built, energised or commissioned. The resource is distinct from tidal site areas and from wind export-cable agreements. Coverage is English, Welsh and Northern Irish waters. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source offers data free of charge under Crown Estate GIS terms, with attribution, distribution and resale restrictions. Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. The resource provides planning or policy-area inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the other Crown Estate wind, tidal and wave agreement layers reviewed in the Thames Estuary catalogue.
